svg.aria-label: The Korext stack: seven open standards (ai-attestation, ai-license, supply-chain-attestation, ai-incident-registry, ai-code-radar, ai-regression-database, commit-carbon) under the Korext Platform, which governs AI generated code and signs a proof bundle for every scan, and enforce-action, which gates every pull request on governance policy.
